scope: Actual current in-app browser playback of a second one-second RGB lossless codec probe with explicit color metadata, not the final film
method: CUA: reload local test page with the new video URL, click play, inspect actual rendered media state and screenshot against the source PNG
observation: The paper background and dark green return to visually expected appearance. The severe pink-purple/bright-green shift in the first probe is absent.
limitations: Visual comparison, not a pixel colorimeter. This one-second still does not establish final full-film decode performance or support in other browsers.
